sections.title: Data Science for the Humanities
sections.description: This course will provide you with a practical introduction to data-driven inquiry in the humanities, with a focus on statistical analysis in the Python programming language. (No prior knowledge of programming is required or expected). See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
